title: Jesus’ Story – The Hand Gospel

sections.title: The Hand Gospel
paragraphs: 1 — Imagine that this is God... The Bible teaches that in the beginning, God made everything.
2 — God made people in a special way, so that they could enjoy a peaceful, loving relationship with him
3 — But the first people sinned by disobeying God. That sin separated all people from God because God is holy.
4 — In many ways, people have tried to remove their sin and please God. However, there is nothing we can do to remove sin from our hearts.
5 — Continuing in sin only leads to death.
6 — But God still loves all people.
7 — This is why he sent the Lord Jesus Christ - to save people from sin. Jesus lived a perfect life and never sinned,
8 — but people killed him on the cross. God planned that Jesus would die for our sins as a sacrifice.
10 — and rose to life again on the third day.
11 — When we believe in Jesus as Lord and Savior, he forgives all our sins…
12 — and restores us to a perfect relationship with God… Would you like to learn more about Jesus?
